segments.text: The password for bandit eight is in data dot txt, on the line with the word millionth.
I log in as bandit7 with ssh bandit7@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
The file holds many lines, each pairing a word with a value separated by a tab, so I run grep millionth on data dot txt.
Grep prints the single matching line, and the value after the tab is the password for bandit eight, and the level is solved.
